title: 第3章 疾风步？
content_zh:
第一卷初临异世 第三章 疾风步？

三个月了，刘枫到这个世界已经有三个月了。。。。

看着天边高悬着的一高一低俩颗太阳，刘枫低声喃喃道:“果然呢，什么都跟地球上不一样啊。”

一双小巧白皙的小手突然遮住刘枫的视线。

“猜猜我是谁？”轻脆得宛如风铃般的声音在身后响起。

被蒙上眼的刘枫嘴角扯出一丝无奈的笑容，哭笑不得的道:“薇儿，你每天都这样，烦不烦啊？”

“真是讨厌，你就不能装做不知道，逗我开心一下吗？”身后的少女。。薇儿。撅着嘴抱怨道。

刘枫转过身，定着眼看着眼前的这位温柔可人的少女，美丽的如蓝宝石的大眼睛，精致的小脸红润的小嘴，一切都是那么的完美，这样的娇艳少女在地球上，谁不是捧在手上怕掉了，含在嘴里怕化了的娇娇公主啊，而且个个眼高于顶，找男朋友最基本的条件：身上穿的是世界名牌，开的是限量轿车，别墅若干座的金龟子，象刘枫这种货色，人家看你的眼光跟看一陀牛屎没什么区别。

可是眼前的少女却是完完全全的属于自己的，心中忽然升出一股冲动，陡然搂住眼前如玉少女的纤腰，拉入怀中，口中不住呢喃，“薇儿，祢真好。”

少女先是一惊，身子一僵，随即便软了下来，小巧的双手反抱着刘枫的虎腰，一双大眼睛弯成了月牙儿。

夕阳斜下，淡红的光芒洒落在这一对小情人的身上，为他们添上了一层美丽的外衣。

“咳”，一声咳嗽声打断了少年少女的缠mian。

“啊”，少女一声娇呼，转过头来刚好看见爷爷脸上那似笑非笑的神情，顿时，一片红云从修长白皙的勃襟顺路的燃烧上了脸颊，纤腰一扭，闪到了刘枫背后，一只小手，在其腰间软肉处，使劲的拧了下去。

“嘶”，刘枫猛的吸了一口凉气，眦着牙苦道:“薇儿，祢太狠了吧。”

少女嘟了嘟小嘴，小声道:“谁叫你自己乱来呢，”看着刘枫脸上那还没褪去的苦笑，“好了，好了嘛，我来帮你揉揉”。

“嘿，我说你们俩个小崽子，还真当老头我不存在啊？”老人见到小俩口毫不遮眼的打情骂俏，不满的道。

“嘿嘿，哈克老爹，找我们有什么事情啊？”刘枫嘻皮笑脸道。

说到正事，哈克老爹收起了笑容，对刘枫轻声道，“再有2天，薇儿就该去学校报到了。”

刘枫顿感正在腰间按摩的小手一紧。

哈克老爹看着薇儿那红通通的眼睛，无奈的摇了摇头，转身边走边说道，“抓紧时间吧，等会回来吃饭。”

枫哥哥，我。。。我。。我不想去学院了。”薇儿看着爷爷远去的身影，撅着小嘴对刘枫道。

“胡闹，”刘枫忽的正容怒道，看着那蓝色的大眼睛里就欲滴落的晶莹，心中一痛，柔声对薇儿说道:“让你进星蓝学院进修，那是哈克老爹的心血，你若是不去了，那岂不是要老爹伤心吗？”

“可是，你。。。你。”薇儿泣道。

“放心吧，我这么大个人，会自己照顾好自己的，倒是你哦，在学院里不要被别的帅哥勾了去哦，呵呵”刘枫调笑道。

“去死吧，坏蛋。”薇儿破涕为笑。

“哈哈，走回去吧，不要要老爹等久了”。

深夜，俩颗月亮高高得悬在天空，月光如水银般的洒落在大地。

刘枫盘腿坐在床上，脑中一片清明，察看着脑海中的那一段莫名的冒出来的信息。

“疾风步”，启动后，身体将完全隐形，速度极快？。。。现在可维持时间为。。10秒。。。在时限内的第一次攻击，将会是本体攻击的2倍。。。技能持续时间可视体内能量的多少而增幅，若体内没有能量支持，将会吸取启动者的体力，直到昏迷为止,技能时间使用间隔：10分钟。

刘枫猛的睁开眼，失声喊道:“疾风步？？剑圣？？？”

压制住内心的狂涌念头，再次查看这段信息，结果还是一样。。

刘枫狂喜不已，能有疾风步，那就会有镜象分身，以及致命一击，甚至是剑刃风暴，那自己变强的希望就不是梦了，只要一想到那天去职业者评定公会被判定为“魔武废人”后，周围那些人的嘲笑声和眼中的不屑，深深的刺痛了刘枫那心底的尊严。

可是现在还有一个问题，那就是能量。。。斗气算是能量，魔法也算是，可是这些都与刘枫无缘，那怎么办呢？

突然，刘枫眼睛一亮，狂笑不已：“哈哈，劳资不会斗气，不会魔法，但是劳资会中华内功啊，我堂堂华夏的精华，岂是这化外夷民之技可以相提并论的。”

内功，华夏武学精华中的精华。。。

不过刘枫会的那点内功可不是那传说中的什么“九阳九阴”以及什么乾坤什么萝鱼，练成之后也不会有什么天现异象啊，什么竹子开花啊，什么十里飘香啊，刘枫会的这点内功只是大众货色而已，当初在起点看奇幻小说看多了，所以上网找到了一本名为≤基本内功≥的秘籍，拿来练了俩年，最后除了似乎身体变高了点之外，就没有什么特别的了，于是一气之下就弃之不管了，想不到在这里成了救命的东西，虽然不知道到底能不能成功，可是这已经是最后的希望了，死马当活马医吧。

刘枫闭上眼，舌抵上颚，眼观与心，再怎么说也已经做了俩年的基本功，现在还是很熟悉的。

慢慢的，脑海里归于清明，想象着身体中有了一丝气流，带着那丝虚幻的气流，沿着固定的经脉路线缓缓移动。。。。一圈。。俩圈。。。还是没有动静，不过刘枫并不着急，他有着当年的经验，曾经盘腿盘了一晚上，不过第二天连床都爬不起来。

不知道转了多少圈之后，刘枫忽然觉得自己似乎看见了一片跟用肉眼看到的不同的世界，这是无数光点的世界，红的，蓝的，绿的，它们不停的游动着。

刘枫突然有了一种明悟，这些光点应该就是这个世界所说的魔法元素和斗气吧。

身体中，虚幻的气流还在不知疲倦的转动着，又是无数转之后，就在刘枫快要坚持不住的时候，身体周围的魔法元素忽然的**了起来，就象是遇到了什么可怕的东西般，一丝白色的气流从魔法元素外围直接横冲直撞了进来，所到之处，元素光点四处逃散，有些不张眼的光点闯进了气流内之后，立刻消失不见，似乎是被白色气流吞噬了？

白色气流终于撞到了刘枫的身上，消失不见，周围的元素光点又恢复了正常的运转。

刘枫狂喜的控制着那一丝进入体内的白色气流，小心的在体内转动着，一个周天后，白色气流也肉眼可见的速度壮大了一圈，钻进了丹田的所在地。

刘枫收功，睁开双眼，一道精光划过眼瞳，又迅速隐去。

跳下了床，快速的打了一套军体拳，虎虎生风，比以前多了几分气势，双拳出击，竟也能带起一点拳风了。

走到窗边，看了一下天空，竟然已快到了白昼了.

“我练了有一晚上了？怎么这么快？古书上说的那些高手，打个坐打十天半个月的难道还是真的？”刘枫兴奋的想道，自己这内功还是很有前途嘛。

“懒猪，太阳都要晒屁股了，你还不起来。”门口传来薇儿独有的宛如风铃的声音。

正要起身开门的刘枫，身体一顿，顽心忽起，眼睛转了转，转身扑到在床上，扯着嗓子高声叫了起来，“哎哟，哎哟，痛死我了，痛啊。”

在门外面撅着嘴的薇儿，正打算是不是要到爷爷那去告上里面那头懒猪一状时，就听到刘枫那如狼嚎的惨叫，呆了一下，连忙推开门，却见到心上人正在那床上滚来滚去，似乎很痛苦的样子，忙扑上去抱住刘枫的后背，泣声道“枫哥哥，你怎么了？不要吓我啊，呜。”

诡计已成的刘枫，一声奸笑，一个狼扑，把惊呼的薇儿扑到在床上。

呆呆的薇儿半晌才明白自己中计了，小嘴一撇，就要哭出声来，却不料，一张大嘴，比她更快一步，吻上了那娇艳欲滴的红润嘴唇，舌头立时开始攻城掠地，疯狂吸掠那甘甜的琼浆玉露。

薇儿乖巧的趴在刘枫怀里，纤纤玉手在刘枫胸口画着圆。

而刘枫则脸上挂着一副奸计得逞的笑容，时不时的升出舌头舔舔嘴唇，表情当真淫荡至极。

“枫哥哥，我现在可是你的人了，你要是敢负了我就把你下面那东西切了，”薇儿突然仰起头，对得意中的刘枫认真的说道，似乎为了表达自己的郑重，还拿小手在刘枫双腿之间虚切了一下。

笑容顿时僵在了脸上，低下头对薇儿干笑道，“那么狠？。”

“怎么？后悔了？”薇儿板着小脸道。

刘枫立刻现出最温柔的笑容，对薇儿柔声道，“怎么可能？能娶你可是我最大的福分，你想后悔我还不答应呢！！”

“那还差不多，嘻嘻，刚才我可是跟你开玩笑的呢，不要害怕哦”薇儿满意的笑道，顺便抚平了刘枫心中的恐惧。

“薇儿，我爱你，直到天崩地裂，海枯石烂，日月无光，宇宙崩塌”

“蒽。。。。。”温柔的傻女人顿时沦陷在了情人编织的甜言蜜语当中。

Volume One: First Arrival in Another World Chapter Three: Wind Step?

It has been three months since Liu Feng came to this world....

Looking at the two suns, one high and one low, hanging high in the sky, Liu Feng murmured in a low voice: "As expected, everything is different from the earth."

A pair of small, white hands suddenly covered Liu Feng's sight.

"Guess who I am?" A voice as light and crisp as a wind chime sounded from behind.

The blindfolded Liu Feng had a helpless smile on his lips, and said in a dumbfounded voice: "Weier, are you tired of being like this every day?"

"It's really annoying. Can't you just pretend you don't know and just make me happy?" the girl behind her said..Weier.He complained with a pout.

Liu Feng turned around and looked intently at the gentle and lovely girl in front of him. She had big eyes as beautiful as sapphires, a delicate face and a rosy mouth. Everything was so perfect. Who on earth would not hold such a charming girl in their hands for fear of losing it, or hold it in their mouth?The most basic conditions for finding a boyfriend are: wearing a world-famous brand, driving a limited-edition car, and having several villas. For someone like Liu Feng, people will look at you like a piece of cow shit.

But the girl in front of him was completely his. An impulse suddenly arose in his heart. He suddenly hugged the slender waist of the jade girl in front of him and pulled her into his arms. He kept murmuring, "Weier, you are so kind."

The girl was startled at first, her body stiffened, and then she softened. Her small hands hugged Liu Feng's waist, and her big eyes curved into crescent moons.

The setting sun was setting, and the pale red light fell on the bodies of the young lovers, adding a beautiful coat to them.

"Cough", a cough interrupted the boy and girl's entanglement.

"Ah", the girl cried out sweetly, and turned her head just in time to see the half-smiling look on her grandfather's face. Suddenly, a red cloud burned from the slender white bodice to her cheeks. She twisted her slim waist and got behind Liu Feng. A small hand twisted hard on the soft part of his waist.

"Hiss", Liu Feng took a deep breath, gritted his teeth and said bitterly: "Weier, you are too cruel."

The girl pouted and whispered: "Who told you to mess around on your own?" Looking at the bitter smile on Liu Feng's face that had not faded, "Okay, okay, I'll rub it for you."

"Hey, you two little brats, do you really think I'm an old man?" The old man said dissatisfied when he saw the young couple flirting openly.

"Hey, Daddy Huck, what do you want from us?" Liu Feng said with a playful smile.

When it came to business, Father Huck put away his smile and whispered to Liu Feng, "In two days, Wei'er should report to school."

Liu Feng suddenly felt the small hand that was massaging his waist tighten.

Father Huck looked at Weier's red eyes, shook his head helplessly, turned around and said, "Hurry up and come back for dinner later."

Brother Feng, me...I..I don't want to go to college."Weier looked at her grandfather's retreating figure and said to Liu Feng with her little mouth pouted.

"Nonsense," Liu Feng suddenly said angrily, looking at the glistening water in his big blue eyes, his heart ached, and he said softly to Wei'er: "Letting you enter Xinglan Academy for further study is Daddy Huck's hard work. If you don't go, won't it make Daddy sad?"

"But, you...you."Weier cried.

"Don't worry. I'm such a big man and I will take care of myself. It's you. Don't be seduced by other handsome guys in the academy, haha," Liu Feng said with a smile.

“Go to hell, you scoundrel."Weier burst into laughter.

"Haha, let's go back. Don't keep dad waiting."

Late at night, two moons hung high in the sky, and the moonlight fell on the earth like mercury.

Liu Feng sat cross-legged on the bed, his mind clear, and he observed the inexplicable piece of information that appeared in his mind.

"Wind Step", after activated, the body will be completely invisible and the speed will be extremely fast?...The current duration is..10 seconds...The first attack within the time limit will be twice the attack of the main body...The skill duration increases depending on the amount of energy in the body. If there is no energy support in the body, the activator's physical strength will be absorbed until he becomes comatose. The skill time interval is: 10 minutes.

Liu Feng opened his eyes suddenly and shouted: "Wind Step??Juggernaut???"

I suppressed the raging thoughts in my heart and checked this information again, but the result was still the same..

Liu Feng was ecstatic. If he could have the Wind Step, he would have a mirror image clone, a fatal blow, and even a blade storm. Then his hope of becoming stronger would no longer be a dream. Just thinking about the day when he went to the Professional Assessment Guild and was judged as a "magical useless person", the ridicule and the disdain in the eyes of those around him deeply hurt the dignity in Liu Feng's heart.

But now there is another problem, and that is energy...Fighting energy is considered energy, and so is magic, but Liu Feng has no chance with these, so what should we do?

Suddenly, Liu Feng's eyes lit up and he laughed wildly: "Haha, labor and management don't know fighting spirit or magic, but labor and management know the internal strength of China. How can the essence of my great China be compared with this skill of transforming foreigners."

Internal strength is the essence of Chinese martial arts...

However, Liu Fenghui's inner strength is not the legendary "nine yangs and nine yins", the universe, and the fish. After practicing it, there will be no celestial phenomena, such as bamboos blooming, or the fragrance of ten miles. Liu Fenghui's inner strength is just a popular commodity. I read too many fantasy novels at Qidian, so I found it on the Internet.I used a secret book called ≤Basic Internal Strength≥ and practiced it for two years. In the end, except that my body seemed to be a little taller, there was nothing special about it, so I abandoned it in a fit of anger. Unexpectedly, it became a life-saving tool here. Although I don’t know whether it will succeed, this is the last hope. Let’s treat a dead horse as a living horse doctor.

Liu Feng closed his eyes, put his tongue against the roof of his mouth, and looked at his eyes and mind. After all, he had been practicing the basic skills for two years, and he was still very familiar with it.

Slowly, my mind returned to clarity, and I imagined that there was a trace of airflow in my body, carrying that illusory airflow, slowly moving along the fixed meridian route....One lap..Two laps...There was still no movement, but Liu Feng was not in a hurry. He had the experience of the past. He had crossed his legs for a whole night, but he couldn't even get out of bed the next day.

After turning around for an unknown number of times, Liu Feng suddenly felt that he seemed to have seen a world different from what he saw with the naked eye. This was a world of countless light spots, red, blue, and green, and they were constantly swimming.

Liu Feng suddenly had an understanding. These light spots should be what the world calls magic elements and fighting spirit.

In his body, the illusory air flow was still spinning tirelessly. After countless rotations, just when Liu Feng was about to lose his hold, the magic elements around his body suddenly ignited, as if he had encountered something terrible. A trace of white air flow rushed in directly from the periphery of the magic element. Wherever it went, elemental light spots scattered in all directions. Some invisible light spots broke into the air flow and disappeared immediately, as if they were swallowed by the white air flow?

The white airflow finally hit Liu Feng's body and disappeared, and the surrounding elemental light spots returned to normal operation.

Liu Feng ecstatically controlled the white airflow that entered his body, and carefully rotated it inside his body. After a week, the white airflow also expanded at a speed visible to the naked eye, and penetrated into the Dantian.

Liu Feng stopped his power and opened his eyes. A ray of light flashed across his eyes and quickly disappeared.

He jumped out of bed and quickly performed a set of martial arts boxing. He was very powerful and had more momentum than before. When he struck with both fists, he was able to create a bit of boxing wind.

I walked to the window and looked at the sky. It was almost daytime.

"Have I been practicing all night?Why so fast?Is it true that the masters mentioned in ancient books meditated for ten days and a half?Liu Feng thought excitedly, his internal skills still have a bright future.

"Lazy pig, the sun is shining on your butt, why don't you get up."Weier's unique sound like wind chimes came from the door.

Liu Feng, who was about to stand up and open the door, paused, suddenly became stubborn, rolled his eyes, turned around and threw himself on the bed, shouting at the top of his lungs, "Ouch, ouch, it hurts me to death, it hurts.""

Wei'er, who was pouting outside the door, was about to go to her grandfather to sue the lazy pig inside when she heard Liu Feng's scream like a wolf. She was stunned for a moment and quickly opened the door, only to see her sweetheart rolling around on the bed, seemingly in pain. She rushed to hug Liu Feng's back and cried, "Brother Feng, what's wrong with you?Don't scare me, ugh."

Liu Feng, whose plot was completed, laughed evilly and pounced, throwing Wei'er, who was screaming in surprise, onto the bed.

It took Wei'er a long time to realize that she had fallen into the trap. She opened her small mouth and was about to cry out. Unexpectedly, a big mouth opened up, one step faster than her, and she kissed the delicate red lips. Her tongue immediately began to attack the city, sucking up the sweet wine and jade dew crazily.

Wei'er lay obediently in Liu Feng's arms, drawing circles on Liu Feng's chest with her slender hands.

Liu Feng, on the other hand, had a smile on his face that showed his scheming was coming to fruition. From time to time, his tongue would come out to lick his lips, his expression was really lustful.

"Brother Feng, I am yours now. If you dare to betray me, I will cut off the thing underneath you," Wei'er suddenly raised her head and said seriously to the proud Liu Feng. As if to express her solemnity, she even used her small hand to make a virtual cut between Liu Feng's legs.

The smile suddenly froze on his face, he lowered his head and smiled dryly at Weier, "So cruel?."

"how?Regret it?"Weier said with a straight face.

Liu Feng immediately showed the gentlest smile and said softly to Wei'er, "How is that possible?Being able to marry you is my greatest blessing. If you want to regret it, I won't agree!!"

"That's pretty much it, hehe, I was joking with you just now, don't be afraid." Weier smiled with satisfaction, calming the fear in Liu Feng's heart.

"Weier, I love you until the sky falls apart, the seas dry up, the sun and the moon lose their light, and the universe collapses."

"Anthracene....."The gentle silly woman suddenly fell into the sweet words spun by her lover.
